module origen_132697 (
    input D,
    input CLK,
    input RESET_B,
    input SCD,
    input SCE,
    input VPWR,
    input VGND,
    input VPB,
    input VNB,
    output Q,
    output Q_N
);

    reg buf_Q;
    wire RESET, mux_out;
    wire notifier, D_delayed, SCD_delayed, SCE_delayed, RESET_B_delayed, CLK_delayed;
    reg awake;
    wire cond0, cond1, cond2, cond3, cond4;

    // Power-up detection
    initial begin
        awake = 1'b0;
        #1;
        awake = 1'b1;
    end

    // Reset signal generation
    assign RESET = ~RESET_B;

    // 2-to-1 multiplexer
    assign mux_out = SCE ? SCD : D;

    // D flip-flop with asynchronous reset and set
    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RESET or negedge SCD) begin
        if (RESET)
            buf_Q <= 1'b0;
        else if (~SCD)
            buf_Q <= 1'b1;
        else
            buf_Q <= mux_out;
    end

    // Output assignments
    assign Q = buf_Q;
    assign Q_N = ~buf_Q;

    // Delay modeling
    specify
        (D +=> Q) = (0:0:0, 0:0:0);
        (CLK +=> Q) = (0:0:0, 0:0:0);
        (RESET_B +=> Q) = (0:0:0, 0:0:0);
        (SCD +=> Q) = (0:0:0, 0:0:0);
        (SCE +=> Q) = (0:0:0, 0:0:0);
    endspecify

endmodule
